title: Uniform Fourier approximation property
statement: For a natural number $n$, a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, a real number $\varepsilon$, and a Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, say that $f$ has a uniform approximation with Fourier support in $\mathcal F$ if there is a function $q:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ such that its Fourier coefficient at every subset outside $\mathcal F$ is zero and $|f(x)-q(x)|<\varepsilon$ for every $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of Fin n
